doc: judge_surface(ref, maps): one row per judged metric (SURFACE_JUDGED order, params.judged; inputs hold the columns params.keys: the six judged ones then the two season terms). v = the metric over the maps; spread = sample std (ddof 1; NaN for one map); season = |ref[season term]| or 0; tolerance = max(2.2 * spread, floor) + season with floor 2.5 for itcz_lat and 0.01 otherwise; diff = mean(v) - ref; pass = tolerance finite and |diff| <= tolerance. Python max(nan, floor) is NaN (the first argument wins when a comparison fails): do not port it as floor. Float64 arithmetic on a handful of numbers: 1e-9; no verdict sits within 1e-6 of a tie, except in exact_ties and just_over_ties, which sit ON one (or an ulp past it) by construction, from exactly representable operations. A single map: the spread is NaN, so tolerance = NaN + season = NaN and every verdict is False (np.isfinite(tol) fails), even a metric whose diff is 0.
